title: Hillshire Farm Sausage Alfredo
description: This creamy sausage Alfredo pasta dish gets flavor from Cajun seasoning and smoked sausage. It’s an easy dinner that’s ready in about 15 minutes.
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) package Hillshire Farm® Smoked Sausage, diagonally cut into 1/4-inch slices

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 10 minutes depending on shape and package directions; drain and set aside.
While pasta is cooking, sauté sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, turning occasionally.
Add cream and Cajun seasoning; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently until mixture begins to thicken, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese.
Add pasta to sauce and toss to serve.

video.description: In this video, you’ll see how to make a creamy smoked sausage and pasta dinner. Ready in 15 minutes, it gets a touch of heat from Cajun seasoning. Less mess, less prep, more flavor! Watch the video, then get the recipe for [Hillshire Farm Sausage Alfredo](http://allrecipes.com/Recipe/Hillshire-Farm-Sausage-Alfredo/Detail.aspx?src=VD_Summary).
